lines.x: Hey, leader! Got some work for us?
Leader, how about we throw a party? We can play some hip-hop and eat apple pie. The best life is the party life! No party, no life!
Locked and loaded, ready for action! What's the objective today, Leader?
Some people believe money can buy anything. But, uh-uh, that saying doesn't really apply to me. Wealth won't make a lick of difference to where my targets end up.
My first wish: more guns! We angels all have a patron firearm, a special gun we grow up with, but owning just one gun is kinda lame. I want eight more!
My second wish: get someone to turn off this light over my head!
I've always got Texas covered, that's why she lives so carefree. So obvious it goes without saying, right?
If you ever run into an angel with black horns oozing ominous vibes, please tell her for me: I've never forgotten her.
Us Penguin Logistics girls ain't so bad, right? What do you say, leader? Wanna come be our boss? Hehe, just kidding.
Oh Lord… is this another soul for us to save?
Password: 'Long live the Penguin Empire.' So you're the client? Call me Exusiai. I'm nothing like that Lupo ice queen. I'm always down for some fun!
I'm lovin' this feeling!
Thanks for the promotion, leader.
Leader... No, savior, I swear on this gun in my hand, I will protect you until the day of reckoning.
Squad combat? I'm very familiar with that.
You've got a good eye. No one makes a better leader than me.
Let's go! Take them all by storm!
Relax, I already called dibs on the most lucrative real estate in Hell, to share with all of you.
All right!
Is it my turn?
Follow me!
Let me double their trouble.
Divine judgment!
Rock n' roll!
Barrage!
Apple pie!
Perfect! Let's keep up the momentum and charge on!
May my hail of bullets bring you eternal peace.
Victory is a heavenly melody. Alright, let's go home and grab some beers!
Life is like a gun, sometimes it just jams. Don't get discouraged, leader, we'll get'em next time.
Wowee! I love this place!
Oh!
Leader, wanna try out my weapon?
Arknights.

Happy New Year, Leader! The party's about to start, Employee Performance Competition Night's over, and I'm not dead last! Here's your booze and apple pie. Let's heat ourselves up to the hip-hop beat, and set this firework tower to the sky~ Here we go! Three, two—BANG!
Sup, leader!

Leader, c'mere, c'mon! Welcome to your birthday party! Turn out the lights and blow out your candles! Oh, but remember, even as the candles go out, my halo will shine on you in the dark. Never worry that you'll lose your way—the angel's Blessings will be forever at your side.

We are led in differing directions. But by your power and wisdom, you may guide us on our journey together. Should the soul in you that protects us be a constant, we too will open a brand new path for you by our souls of honesty and ardor.
